FOOTPRINT · LEGAL & YOUR DATA

Data & account deletion

Know where to find information about your account, activity, and location records.

Landing page preview. Updated October 22, 2026. App-specific contacts and procedures are awaiting confirmation.

Launch status

A verified deletion or data-request channel for the Footprint app has not yet been provided. This preview page cannot process requests and does not collect account identifiers, health information, or location records.

Before the app launches

The operator must provide an authenticated in-app deletion flow or a verified request channel, and explain how to identify an account without asking for unnecessary sensitive information.

What the final instructions must cover

Instructions must distinguish deleting an account from deleting individual nutrition, workout, or route records. They should explain effects on squad posts and event participation, processing timelines, backups, and any documented retention exceptions.

Permission and visibility controls

Device location permission settings, route visibility, and account deletion are different controls. Final documentation should explain what each control does and how it affects previously collected information.

Need help now?

Use an existing verified app support channel if one is available to you. No support email or data submission form is presented on this preview because the official contact has not been confirmed.
